headline: Six Fronts Surge as Bases Trade Hands
war_summary: Since the 03:10 edition the war has reshaped on a half‑dozen sectors. Stlican Shelf remains the hottest flashpoint, logging eight ownership flips in the past six hours and a combined casualty rate of roughly 100 colonial and 98 warden losses per hour. Weathered Expanse, still the bloodiest theater, has paused its rapid turnover — no flips in the last two hours but three in the prior six — while casualties stay extreme at about 380 colonial and 420 warden per hour. Godcrofts continues its eruption with twelve flips in six hours and rising losses (≈70 colonial, 65 warden per hour). Fishermans Row has intensified, recording fourteen flips in six hours and accelerating casualties (≈400 colonial, 590 warden per hour). Stonecradle, after an earlier surge, shows no new flips in six hours yet sustains high attrition (≈255 colonial, 331 warden per hour). Linn Mercy added four flips in six hours with casualties climbing to roughly 400 colonial and 610 warden per hour. Callahan’s Passage, quiet for six hours, now registers three flips. Farranac Coast remains static with no recent changes. All other sectors report no ownership activity.
